tool.name: SNP and Sample QC
tool.description: Filters genotype data based on missingness and MAF

param.name: genotypes_file
param.label: Genotypes File
param.help: A tab-separated file with samples as rows and SNPs as columns.

param.name: snp_annot_file
param.label: SNP Annotation File
param.help: A tab-separated file with SNP information, including a 'maf' column.

param.name: pheno_file
param.label: Phenotypes/Covariates File (Optional)
param.help: Optional tab-separated file with sample information.

param.name: maf_thresh
param.label: MAF Threshold
param.help: Remove SNPs with MAF below this value.

param.name: snp_miss
param.label: SNP Missingness Threshold
param.help: Remove SNPs with missing data in more than this fraction of samples.

param.name: sample_miss
param.label: Sample Missingness Threshold
param.help: Remove samples with missing data for more than this fraction of SNPs.

param.name: missing_val
param.label: Missing Value Representation
param.help: The string used to denote missing genotypes (e.g., 'NA', '-1').

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool performs standard quality control on GWAS data. It filters out unreliable SNPs and samples based on user-defined thresholds for:
- **SNP Missingness:** Removes SNPs that fail to genotype in too many samples. - **Minor Allele Frequency (MAF):** Removes very rare SNPs that lack statistical power. - **Sample Missingness:** Removes samples (individuals) with poor quality DNA that resulted in too many missing SNP calls.
**Inputs**
- **Genotypes File:** A tab-separated file where rows are samples and columns are SNPs. - **SNP Annotation File:** A tab-separated file containing at least 'snp_id' and 'maf' columns. - **Phenotypes File (Optional):** If provided, it will be filtered to match the samples that pass QC.
**Outputs**
- **Filtered Data:** Filtered versions of the genotype, SNP, and phenotype files. - **QC Report:** A text file summarizing how many SNPs and samples were removed at each step. - **Kept Sample List:** A simple, one-column file listing the 'sample_id' of every sample that passed QC.
